title: Mobile Wallet Resend Rate Card: Principal-Size Uplift
content:
FX desk rate card for **Mobile Wallet** resends of larger transfers.

**Uplift rule.** The principal uplift on a resend follows the principal collected on the transfer, that is the total of its funds-received entries:

| Principal collected (USD) | Principal uplift |
|---|---|
| 1500.00 or more | 0.10 points |
| at least 1000.00 and below 1500.00 | 0.05 points |
| below 1000.00 | nothing |

*Hypothetical boundaries:* a principal collected of 999.99 earns nothing; 1000.00 earns 0.05 points; 1499.99 earns 0.05 points; 1500.00 earns 0.10 points. The principal collected is what the customer paid in for the transfer, not what Paloma holds at the time of the resend.
